_comment: Expected identity of ONE machine (MSI B850 GAMING PLUS WIFI6E / RTX 3060 GA106). This file is not a hardware profile and grants nothing: it only lets msi_b850_gate.py refuse inventories and generated LOCAL profiles that describe a different machine. Every value below 'reported_by_owner' was supplied by the machine owner from Windows; every null value is unknown until read-only probe captures exist. Never fill a null from another machine.

derived_from_owner_values._comment: Mechanical encodings of the owner's PCI IDs in the form generated headers use (device<<16 | vendor).

repository_reviewed_traits._comment: Taken from internal-boot/unlock/gpu-family.h and research/profile/proven.json; the gate re-reads proven.json instead of trusting this copy.

unknown_until_probe: PCI segment/bus and complete root-port ancestry of the RTX
NVIDIA GOP (nvgop) version and .text SHA-256 in this card's VBIOS
AMI console text/graphics driver fingerprints in BIOS 1.A20
whether an EDID driver is bound (GU_NO_EDID_DRIVER)
console topology: aggregate or direct, number of RTX display children
whether the AMD iGPU publishes a physical GOP in this BIOS configuration
PciIo attribute cache versus PCI command register (CapturePermit)
whether MSI firmware keeps and boots an NVRAM entry that points at a second ESP
